with open('src/click/shell_completion.py', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find the _SOURCE_BASH template
import re
match = re.search(r'(_SOURCE_BASH = """[^"]*""")', content)
if match:
    print("Found _SOURCE_BASH at position:", match.start())
    # Print the full template
    start = content.find('_SOURCE_BASH = """')
    end = content.find('"""', start + len('_SOURCE_BASH = """')) + 3
    print(content[start:end])
